transformers.note: library_name is `cosmos`; the documented inference engines are vLLM-Omni, vLLM and PyTorch, and the card shows no transformers example. Loading it through AutoModelForImageTextToText is not a documented usage.

resources._note: Not a memory constraint — a decode one. transformers 5.x falls back to torchvision for video decoding, and eight workers concurrently decoding 400-second episodes exhausted decoder resources (swscaler EAGAIN) on 104 of 150 episode questions. Two cards per worker halves concurrent decodes; the model is small and fast enough that four replicas keep up.
